tx-level constraint: commits to a local-script bin (arg 0 must be inline literal)
invoke a previously-redeemed local script: callRedeemer(<32-byte-literal-hash>, <fnIdx-byte>, args...)

tx-level native-token declaration: token(<32-byte-tag-literal>, <1-byte-foundryProducedIdx-literal>). foundryProducedIdx == 0xFF means pure conservation (delta 0); any other byte names a produced foundry output for a mint/burn transit.

UTXO-level native-token instance: tokenAmount(<32-byte-tag-literal>, <amount-uint64-literal>). Tag must be declared at tx level by token(). Accounts amount onto the per-tag consumed/produced sum at evaluation time.
